name: AI-dol
source:
Welcome to the future, where AI permeates almost every sector of life! In this story, you will play as Juniper Yan, a fresh college graduate who gets hired as an idol group manager. But they're not just any idol group . . . !

[From [url=https://ruo-ze.itch.io/ai-dol]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到人工智能几乎渗透到生活各个领域的未来！在这个故事中，你将扮演Juniper Yan，一名应届大学毕业生，被聘为偶像团体经理。但他们并不是普通的偶像团体。。。！
